newsitem.title: USA: COMSAT to restructure, focus on satellites.
newsitem.headline: COMSAT to restructure, focus on satellites.

text.p: Communications provider COMSAT Corp said Monday its board had approved a plan to restructure the company around its core businesses -- satellite and network services.
"As a result of the restructuring actions, COMSAT will be a smaller, more focused company with a stronger balance sheet," it said.
The company, which has postponed its annual meeting previously scheduled for May, said its board was "reviewing whether COMSAT should maintain its dividend at the current level."
It said it was going to refinance a portion of its long-term debt with the proceeds of short-term debt financing in order to increase its financial flexibility.
COMSAT said it was going ahead with plans to sell its 80.67-percent stake in Ascent Entertainment Group Inc.
It has filed with the Internal Revenue Service for a ruling to allow the spin-off of Ascent as a tax-free dividend to shareholders. It expects a ruling by May.
The company said it plans to sell "substantially all" of the assets and operations of COMSAT RSI Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary that makes earth stations and wireless and advanced antenna systems.
It said its plan concentrates on international satellite services and digital networking services and technology.
It said it would retain Morgan Stanley & Co to assist with the implementation of its strategic plan and the sale of assets.
